name: @griches/apple-calendar-mcp
description: MCP server for interacting with Apple Calendar on macOS

scripts.build:swift: swiftc -O -target arm64-apple-macosx13.0 -o build/calendar-helper-arm64 swift/CalendarHelper.swift -framework EventKit -framework Foundation && swiftc -O -target x86_64-apple-macosx13.0 -o build/calendar-helper-x86_64 swift/CalendarHelper.swift -framework EventKit -framework Foundation && lipo -create build/calendar-helper-arm64 build/calendar-helper-x86_64 -output build/calendar-helper && rm build/calendar-helper-arm64 build/calendar-helper-x86_64
